note: Card imagery is public domain (Rider-Waite-Smith, 1909). Interpretations written for this project.

cards.name: The Fool
cards.essence: A leap taken before you can see where you land.
cards.light: A fresh start with nothing weighing you down. Trusting the step even without a map.
cards.shadow: Recklessness dressed as courage. Ignoring a cliff edge because looking down is inconvenient.
cards.reversed: Hesitating at the threshold, or leaping without any thought at all.
cards.description: A young traveller steps toward a cliff with a small bundle and a white rose, a little dog barking at their heels.

cards.name: The Magician
cards.essence: You already hold everything the task requires.
cards.light: Intention turned into action. Resources and talent lining up behind a single clear aim.
cards.shadow: Cleverness used to manipulate. Talk and showmanship standing in for real substance.
cards.reversed: Scattered power, untapped potential, or a trick being played on you.
cards.description: A figure raises a wand skyward with the other hand pointing to earth, the four suit symbols laid out on the table before them.

cards.name: The High Priestess
cards.essence: What you know but have not yet admitted knowing.
cards.light: Deep inner knowing. The answer arrives by listening rather than reasoning it out.
cards.shadow: Secrets kept too long. Withdrawal into silence when something needs to be said aloud.
cards.reversed: Ignored instincts, or information deliberately withheld from you.
cards.description: A veiled woman sits between two pillars, a crescent moon at her feet and a scroll half hidden in her lap.

cards.name: The Empress
cards.essence: Something is growing and it needs feeding, not forcing.
cards.light: Fertile, generous, comfortable. Creation that comes easily and pleasure taken without guilt.
cards.shadow: Smothering care. Indulgence that softens into laziness, or giving until nothing is left.
cards.reversed: Creative block, neglect of yourself, or dependence dressed up as love.
cards.description: A crowned woman reclines among ripe wheat and cushions in a lush garden, a shield bearing the sign of Venus beside her.

cards.name: The Emperor
cards.essence: Order imposed on chaos, for better or worse.
cards.light: Stability, clear boundaries, someone taking responsibility. Rules that genuinely protect.
cards.shadow: Rigidity and control. Authority that has forgotten it exists to serve rather than dominate.
cards.reversed: Domineering behaviour, or a collapse of the structure you were relying on.
cards.description: A stern bearded ruler sits on a stone throne carved with rams' heads, against barren mountains.

cards.name: The Hierophant
cards.essence: The established way of doing things.
cards.light: Wisdom passed down. Finding your place in something older and larger than yourself.
cards.shadow: Conformity for its own sake. Dogma repeated by people who stopped asking why.
cards.reversed: Breaking with convention, questioning the teaching, or unorthodoxy for its own sake.
cards.description: A robed religious figure raises a hand in blessing over two initiates, crossed keys at his feet.

cards.name: The Lovers
cards.essence: A choice that reveals what you actually value.
cards.light: Genuine connection and alignment. Choosing with your whole self rather than half of it.
cards.shadow: Temptation and divided loyalty. A decision dodged until it decides itself.
cards.reversed: Disharmony, a mismatch of values, or avoiding the choice in front of you.
cards.description: A naked man and woman stand beneath a winged angel, a serpent coiled in the tree behind her.

cards.name: The Chariot
cards.essence: Opposing forces held together by sheer will.
cards.light: Determination that gets there. Conflicting pressures mastered and pointed one direction.
cards.shadow: Force over finesse. Winning the race while losing sight of why you entered it.
cards.reversed: Loss of direction, spinning wheels, or aggression standing in for progress.
cards.description: An armoured figure rides a chariot drawn by one black and one white sphinx, holding no reins.

cards.name: Strength
cards.essence: The soft hand closes the lion's mouth.
cards.light: Quiet bravery. Influence through gentleness, and appetites handled without shame or war.
cards.shadow: Forcing what should be coaxed, or letting the lion run the house.
cards.reversed: Self-doubt, raw impulse taking over, or strength spent on the wrong fight.
cards.description: A woman in white calmly closes a lion's jaws with her bare hands, an infinity symbol above her head.

cards.name: The Hermit
cards.essence: Stepping back far enough to hear yourself think.
cards.light: Deliberate withdrawal that produces real insight. Becoming the one who carries the lamp.
cards.shadow: Isolation that curdles. Retreat used to avoid people rather than to find clarity.
cards.reversed: Loneliness, or refusing the solitude you badly need.
cards.description: A cloaked old man stands on a snowy peak holding a lantern with a six-pointed star inside.

cards.name: Wheel of Fortune
cards.essence: The situation is about to turn, with or without your permission.
cards.light: A lucky turn and the arrival of the moment you were waiting for. Momentum shifting your way.
cards.shadow: What rises also falls. Circumstances outside your control taking the wheel.
cards.reversed: Bad timing, a downturn, or resisting a cycle that has already finished.
cards.description: A great wheel marked with mystic letters turns in the sky, surrounded by four winged creatures reading books.

cards.name: Justice
cards.essence: Consequences arrive, correctly weighed.
cards.light: The honest outcome. Balance restored and responsibility taken cleanly.
cards.shadow: Cold judgement without mercy, or a reckoning you would rather not face.
cards.reversed: Unfairness, bias, dishonesty, or dodging accountability.
cards.description: A crowned figure sits holding an upright sword in one hand and level scales in the other.

cards.name: The Hanged Man
cards.essence: Suspended on purpose, seeing it all upside down.
cards.light: A willing pause that reframes everything. Letting go of control to gain understanding.
cards.shadow: Martyrdom and stalling. Calling it patience when it is really paralysis.
cards.reversed: Pointless delay, resistance to letting go, or sacrifice nobody asked for.
cards.description: A man hangs serenely by one ankle from a living tree, his free leg crossed and a halo around his head.

cards.name: Death
cards.essence: An ending, and therefore a beginning.
cards.light: Clean transformation. What is finished finally makes room for what comes next.
cards.shadow: Loss that genuinely hurts, and the exhausting refusal to let a dead thing go.
cards.reversed: Clinging to what has ended, or a change stalled halfway through.
cards.description: A skeleton in black armour rides a white horse past fallen figures, a sunrise breaking between two towers behind.

cards.name: Temperance
cards.essence: The right proportions, found by patient mixing.
cards.light: Opposites blended into something better than either. Healing that takes its own time.
cards.shadow: Endless moderation that never commits. Over-dilution until nothing has flavour.
cards.reversed: Excess, impatience, or two things that simply will not blend.
cards.description: A winged angel pours liquid between two cups, one foot on land and one in the water.

cards.name: The Devil
cards.essence: The chains are loose, which is the uncomfortable part.
cards.light: Honest recognition of desire and what has a hold on you. Naming it is how it loosens.
cards.shadow: Addiction, obsession, and staying in a bad arrangement because leaving is harder.
cards.reversed: Breaking free, or sinking deeper while insisting you could stop any time.
cards.description: A horned figure squats above two chained human figures whose collars are loose enough to lift off.

cards.name: The Tower
cards.essence: What was built wrong comes down all at once.
cards.light: A necessary demolition. The lie collapses and you are standing in sudden, useful truth.
cards.shadow: Shock, disruption, and real damage arriving without warning or consent.
cards.reversed: A disaster narrowly avoided, or a collapse you keep postponing.
cards.description: Lightning strikes a tall tower, knocking off its crown as two figures fall headlong from the windows.

cards.name: The Star
cards.essence: Quiet hope after the worst has already happened.
cards.light: Calm restoration and renewed faith. Being seen clearly and not needing to hide.
cards.shadow: Wishful thinking untethered from effort, or hope so faint you stop trusting it.
cards.reversed: Discouragement, lost faith, or feeling spiritually disconnected.
cards.description: A naked woman kneels by a pool pouring water onto land and into the water, one great star and seven small above.

cards.name: The Moon
cards.essence: Not everything you are seeing is really there.
cards.light: Rich imagination and dreams worth listening to. Navigating by feel through genuine fog.
cards.shadow: Deception and projected fear. Mistaking your own anxiety for information.
cards.reversed: Confusion clearing, secrets surfacing, or fear finally losing its grip.
cards.description: A dog and a wolf howl at a face in the moon while a crayfish crawls from a pool onto a winding path.

cards.name: The Sun
cards.essence: Everything, briefly, is simple and good.
cards.light: Warmth, success and straightforward happiness. Nothing hidden and nothing to explain.
cards.shadow: Naive optimism, or a brightness so relentless it burns what it shines on.
cards.reversed: Dimmed spirits, delayed happiness, or forced cheerfulness.
cards.description: A naked child rides a white horse beneath an enormous radiant sun, sunflowers rising over a wall behind.

cards.name: Judgement
cards.essence: The call to account for it and rise anyway.
cards.light: Clear-eyed reckoning with the past and genuine renewal. Answering a call you can finally hear.
cards.shadow: Harsh self-judgement, or the paralysis of being weighed and found wanting.
cards.reversed: Ignoring the call, self-doubt, or refusing to forgive yourself.
cards.description: An angel blows a trumpet as pale figures rise from open coffins with their arms lifted.

cards.name: The World
cards.essence: The circle closes, complete.
cards.light: Genuine completion and belonging. The long thing is finished and it was worth finishing.
cards.shadow: Clinging to an ending, or an achievement that feels oddly hollow once reached.
cards.reversed: Loose ends, delayed completion, or a chapter that refuses to close.
cards.description: A dancing figure wrapped in a violet scarf floats within a laurel wreath, the four winged creatures at the corners.

cards.name: Ace of Cups
cards.essence: The heart opens without being asked to.
cards.light: A fresh emotional beginning. Love, compassion or creativity arriving in full.
cards.shadow: Overwhelm, or an offered feeling that spills before it can be received.
cards.reversed: Blocked emotion, self-love withheld, or a cup poured out too soon.
cards.description: A hand from a cloud offers an overflowing chalice with a dove descending toward it.

cards.name: Two of Cups
cards.essence: Two people meeting each other exactly halfway.
cards.light: Genuine connection between equals. Attraction, reconciliation, or a promise made honestly.
cards.shadow: Imbalance hidden under romance. One cup filling while the other empties.
cards.reversed: Disharmony, a broken bond, or a connection that has quietly gone one-sided.
cards.description: A man and woman exchange cups beneath a winged lion's head entwined with serpents.

cards.name: Three of Cups
cards.essence: Good news is better with other people in the room.
cards.light: Real friendship and something worth toasting. Belonging that costs you nothing to accept.
cards.shadow: Excess and shallow company. Celebration used to avoid a conversation.
cards.reversed: Gossip, a falling-out, or feeling on the outside of the party.
cards.description: Three women raise their cups together in a circle among vines and fruit.

cards.name: Four of Cups
cards.essence: A fourth cup is being offered and you are not looking.
cards.light: Honest boredom that signals a real need for change. Turning inward before deciding.
cards.shadow: Sulking. Missing a genuine offer because dissatisfaction has become comfortable.
cards.reversed: Waking up, accepting the offer, or restlessness finally breaking.
cards.description: A man sits under a tree with arms folded, ignoring a cup held out by a cloud.

cards.name: Five of Cups
cards.essence: Three cups spilled, two still standing behind you.
cards.light: Grief given its due. Mourning honestly is what eventually lets you turn around.
cards.shadow: Fixation on what was lost while what survived goes unnoticed.
cards.reversed: Acceptance, moving on, or being rushed through grief before you are ready.
cards.description: A cloaked figure stares down at three spilled cups, unaware of two upright ones behind.

cards.name: Six of Cups
cards.essence: The past, remembered kindly.
cards.light: Sweet memory and simple generosity. Reconnecting with something or someone from before.
cards.shadow: Living backwards. A golden past that never quite existed as remembered.
cards.reversed: Stuck in nostalgia, or finally leaving childhood patterns behind.
cards.description: A child offers another a cup filled with flowers in the courtyard of an old garden.

cards.name: Seven of Cups
cards.essence: Too many options, most of them imaginary.
cards.light: Imagination running rich with possibility. Everything still open, nothing yet ruled out.
cards.shadow: Daydreaming instead of choosing. Glittering options that dissolve when touched.
cards.reversed: Clarity arriving, or commitment to one path at last.
cards.description: A silhouetted figure faces seven cups floating in cloud, each holding a different vision.

cards.name: Eight of Cups
cards.essence: Walking away from something that was almost enough.
cards.light: The courage to leave what no longer feeds you, even when nothing is technically wrong.
cards.shadow: Chronic leaving. Abandoning good things in search of a feeling.
cards.reversed: Returning, staying too long, or fear of walking away.
cards.description: A figure walks away toward mountains under an eclipsed moon, leaving eight cups stacked behind.

cards.name: Nine of Cups
cards.essence: The wish, granted.
cards.light: Getting what you wanted and enjoying it properly. Comfort thoroughly earned.
cards.shadow: Smugness and surface pleasure. Wanting the wrong thing and receiving it in full.
cards.reversed: Dissatisfaction despite success, or a wish that disappoints on arrival.
cards.description: A well-fed man sits with folded arms and a satisfied smile before a curved counter of nine cups.

cards.name: Ten of Cups
cards.essence: The picture of happiness, actually inhabited.
cards.light: Lasting emotional contentment. Home, chosen or given, and peace among the people in it.
cards.shadow: Performing happiness. A perfect image maintained at the cost of what is real.
cards.reversed: Discord at home, or a gap between the picture and the feeling.
cards.description: A couple raise their arms toward a rainbow of ten cups while two children dance beside them.

cards.name: Page of Cups
cards.essence: A surprising feeling, delivered sincerely.
cards.light: Openness and gentle imagination. An unexpected message or a tender new feeling.
cards.shadow: Emotional immaturity. Feelings too easily bruised and too quickly shared.
cards.reversed: Moodiness, insecurity, or a creative impulse left unexpressed.
cards.description: A young figure in a flowered tunic regards a fish improbably lifting its head from a cup.

cards.name: Knight of Cups
cards.essence: Following the heart wherever it happens to point.
cards.light: Romantic, imaginative and sincere. Arriving with an offer made in good faith.
cards.shadow: All charm and no follow-through. In love with the feeling rather than the person.
cards.reversed: Moodiness, unrealistic promises, or jealousy under the charm.
cards.description: A knight in winged helmet rides a walking white horse, holding out a single cup.

cards.name: Queen of Cups
cards.essence: Feeling everything, and staying steady anyway.
cards.light: Deep empathy paired with real emotional steadiness. Holding space without drowning.
cards.shadow: Absorbing everyone's feelings until your own are unreachable. Care that becomes control.
cards.reversed: Emotional overwhelm, martyrdom, or intuition second-guessed into silence.
cards.description: A queen sits at the water's edge gazing intently into an ornate lidded cup.

cards.name: King of Cups
cards.essence: Calm on a sea that is not calm.
cards.light: Feeling deeply and governing it well. The steady person others bring their troubles to.
cards.shadow: Composure used as a wall. Emotion managed so tightly it never actually surfaces.
cards.reversed: Volatility, manipulation through feeling, or emotions bottled to breaking point.
cards.description: A king sits on a throne floating on choppy water, holding a cup, untroubled by the waves.

cards.name: Ace of Wands
cards.essence: The spark, before anything has been built.
cards.light: A surge of creative energy and genuine enthusiasm. The idea that makes you stand up.
cards.shadow: Sparks that never catch. Excitement burning out before the work begins.
cards.reversed: Delays, false starts, or motivation that will not ignite.
cards.description: A hand from a cloud grips a sprouting wooden wand above a green landscape with a distant castle.

cards.name: Two of Wands
cards.essence: Holding the world and deciding whether to leave.
cards.light: Surveying the wider world and planning a real move. Ambition with a map.
cards.shadow: Endless planning from the safety of the balcony. The trip never quite booked.
cards.reversed: Fear of the unknown, cancelled plans, or playing it too safe.
cards.description: A man on a castle rampart holds a globe, looking out to sea between two tall wands.

cards.name: Three of Wands
cards.essence: The ships you sent out are on their way back.
cards.light: Plans in motion and returns beginning to arrive. Long-range thinking rewarded.
cards.shadow: Watching the horizon instead of the work. Expansion outrunning foundations.
cards.reversed: Delays, thwarted plans, or a narrow view of what is possible.
cards.description: A cloaked figure stands on a cliff between three planted wands, watching ships on a golden sea.

cards.name: Four of Wands
cards.essence: A threshold crossed and marked properly.
cards.light: Joyful arrival. A stable foundation reached and worth celebrating with others.
cards.shadow: Ceremony without substance, or a milestone that quietly traps you.
cards.reversed: A muted celebration, instability at home, or a transition without closure.
cards.description: Two figures raise bouquets beneath a garland strung between four standing wands, a castle behind.

cards.name: Five of Wands
cards.essence: Everyone talking, nobody listening.
cards.light: Productive friction. Competition that sharpens everyone involved and clarifies positions.
cards.shadow: Pointless squabbling. Energy burnt on a fight with no prize at the end.
cards.reversed: Conflict avoided or resolved, or tension driven underground.
cards.description: Five youths brandish staves in a disorganised scuffle that could be a fight or a game.

cards.name: Six of Wands
cards.essence: The win, publicly acknowledged.
cards.light: Success recognised by others. Confidence that has been genuinely earned.
cards.shadow: Needing the applause. A reputation that becomes heavier than the achievement.
cards.reversed: Lack of recognition, a fall from favour, or private doubt behind a public win.
cards.description: A rider crowned with laurel parades on horseback through a crowd, a wreath on his wand.

cards.name: Seven of Wands
cards.essence: Higher ground, held against all comers.
cards.light: Standing your ground on something that matters. Defending a position worth defending.
cards.shadow: Defensiveness as a permanent posture. Fighting off help along with the threats.
cards.reversed: Overwhelm, giving up the position, or exhaustion from constant defence.
cards.description: A man on a hilltop fends off six wands rising from below, wearing mismatched boots.

cards.name: Eight of Wands
cards.essence: Everything happening at once, quickly.
cards.light: Rapid progress and news arriving. Obstacles clear and things finally move.
cards.shadow: Too fast to steer. Haste that scatters effort in eight directions.
cards.reversed: Delays, stalled momentum, or a message that does not come.
cards.description: Eight wands fly in parallel through open sky above a river and green hills.

cards.name: Nine of Wands
cards.essence: Battered, still standing, one more round.
cards.light: Hard-won resilience. Nearly through, and refusing to fall at the final hurdle.
cards.shadow: Exhaustion and suspicion. Braced for an attack that may not be coming.
cards.reversed: Burnout, paranoia, or giving up just short of the finish.
cards.description: A bandaged man leans on a wand, watching warily, eight more standing like a fence behind him.

cards.name: Ten of Wands
cards.essence: Carrying all of it, badly.
cards.light: Real responsibility shouldered and nearly delivered. The load is heavy because it matters.
cards.shadow: Taking on everything and delegating nothing. Effort mistaken for necessity.
cards.reversed: Putting the load down, collapse, or refusing to share the weight.
cards.description: A man staggers toward a distant town, arms full of ten wands that block his view.

cards.name: Page of Wands
cards.essence: Fired up about something new.
cards.light: Fresh enthusiasm and free exploration. Willing to try before knowing how.
cards.shadow: All ignition, no endurance. Passion that moves on to the next thing by Thursday.
cards.reversed: Restlessness, unreliable news, or ambition with no plan behind it.
cards.description: A young figure in a salamander-patterned tunic stands in a desert, examining a sprouting wand.

cards.name: Knight of Wands
cards.essence: Charging in, working it out on the way.
cards.light: Fearless action and infectious energy. The one who actually goes.
cards.shadow: Recklessness. Starting fires with enormous confidence and leaving before they are out.
cards.reversed: Frustration, delays, or bravado covering a lack of direction.
cards.description: An armoured knight on a rearing horse holds a sprouting wand, salamanders on his tunic.

cards.name: Queen of Wands
cards.essence: Warm, certain, impossible to overlook.
cards.light: Self-assured warmth that draws people in. Courage worn lightly and generously.
cards.shadow: Needing to be the brightest thing in the room. Warmth that turns scorching when crossed.
cards.reversed: Insecurity, jealousy, or confidence performed rather than felt.
cards.description: A queen sits facing forward with a sunflower and a wand, a black cat at her feet.

cards.name: King of Wands
cards.essence: Vision, plus the nerve to make people follow it.
cards.light: Natural leadership and long vision. Inspiring others toward something genuinely worth doing.
cards.shadow: Imperiousness and impatience. A visionary who will not be told anything.
cards.reversed: Arrogance, tyranny, or big talk with nothing built underneath.
cards.description: A king on a throne carved with lions and salamanders holds a flowering wand, a lizard at his feet.

cards.name: Ace of Swords
cards.essence: The thought that cuts straight through.
cards.light: Sudden mental clarity. The truth stated plainly and the decision that follows from it.
cards.shadow: Truth used as a weapon. A blade is clarity and injury in the same object.
cards.reversed: Confusion, muddled thinking, or clarity misused.
cards.description: A hand from a cloud raises an upright sword crowned with a wreath, mountains below.

cards.name: Two of Swords
cards.essence: Blindfolded, holding both options at arm's length.
cards.light: A deliberate pause before deciding. Refusing to be rushed into the wrong choice.
cards.shadow: Willful blindness. A decision avoided so long that it makes itself.
cards.reversed: The blindfold coming off, a stalemate breaking, or information finally arriving.
cards.description: A blindfolded woman sits before moonlit water holding two crossed swords in perfect balance.

cards.name: Three of Swords
cards.essence: It hurts because it is true.
cards.light: The clean pain of honesty. Something finally named, which is where healing starts.
cards.shadow: Sorrow, betrayal, and words that cannot be taken back.
cards.reversed: Recovery beginning, or pain nursed long after the wound closed.
cards.description: Three swords pierce a red heart suspended against grey rain clouds.

cards.name: Four of Swords
cards.essence: Put it down and sleep.
cards.light: Necessary rest and genuine recuperation. Stepping back to come back sharper.
cards.shadow: Withdrawal that hardens into avoidance. Rest that becomes hiding.
cards.reversed: Restlessness, burnout ignored, or a return to activity too soon.
cards.description: A stone effigy of a knight lies at rest in a chapel, three swords above and one beneath.

cards.name: Five of Swords
cards.essence: You won. Look around.
cards.light: Seeing clearly what a fight actually cost. Knowing when winning is not worth it.
cards.shadow: Victory at any price. Being right while everyone walks away from you.
cards.reversed: Making amends, or a defeat that stings longer than it should.
cards.description: A smirking figure gathers swords while two others walk away, heads down, under a ragged sky.

cards.name: Six of Swords
cards.essence: Leaving, quietly, toward calmer water.
cards.light: A move away from trouble toward something calmer. Passage out, even if sadly.
cards.shadow: Carrying the swords with you. Geography changed, problem unchanged.
cards.reversed: Being unable to leave, a delayed departure, or resistance to moving on.
cards.description: A ferryman poles a boat carrying a cloaked woman and child, six swords upright in the hull.

cards.name: Seven of Swords
cards.essence: Getting away with it, mostly.
cards.light: Cleverness and strategy. Knowing when to act alone rather than announce yourself.
cards.shadow: Deception and betrayal. Taking what is not yours and calling it initiative.
cards.reversed: Getting caught, confession, or deceiving yourself most of all.
cards.description: A man creeps away from a camp carrying five swords, two still planted in the ground behind him.

cards.name: Eight of Swords
cards.essence: The cage has no back to it.
cards.light: Recognising that the trap is mostly mental. Seeing the gap is how you leave through it.
cards.shadow: Feeling genuinely powerless. Talked out of your own options, including by yourself.
cards.reversed: Freeing yourself, or sinking further into a victim story.
cards.description: A bound and blindfolded woman stands among eight swords planted in mud, none of them touching her.

cards.name: Nine of Swords
cards.essence: Three in the morning, and the mind will not stop.
cards.light: Fear brought into the open where it can be examined and sized honestly.
cards.shadow: Anguish out of proportion. Suffering the same disaster nightly in advance.
cards.reversed: Relief, morning coming, or despair kept secret.
cards.description: A figure sits up in bed with face in hands, nine swords mounted on the wall behind.

cards.name: Ten of Swords
cards.essence: Rock bottom, which at least has a floor.
cards.light: The worst has now happened, so it can stop happening. Dawn is already on the horizon.
cards.shadow: Painful, total defeat. Betrayal that overdoes it well past the point of necessity.
cards.reversed: Slow recovery, survival, or melodrama over a smaller wound.
cards.description: A figure lies face down beneath ten swords in the back, as a black sky lifts to gold at the horizon.

cards.name: Page of Swords
cards.essence: Curious, watchful, and slightly too keen to tell you.
cards.light: Sharp curiosity and mental energy. Asking the question everyone else avoided.
cards.shadow: Gossip and cynicism. Cleverness practised at other people's expense.
cards.reversed: Scattered thinking, idle talk, or information that proves unreliable.
cards.description: A youth stands on windswept ground holding a sword upright, turning as if just interrupted.

cards.name: Knight of Swords
cards.essence: Right, fast, and not stopping to check.
cards.light: Decisive, fearless and quick to act on a clear idea. Cuts through the dithering.
cards.shadow: Charging in without looking. Certainty travelling much faster than the facts.
cards.reversed: Recklessness, aggression, or a burst of energy that collapses.
cards.description: A knight gallops headlong into the wind with sword raised, his horse at full stretch.

cards.name: Queen of Swords
cards.essence: She has heard the excuse before.
cards.light: Clear sight and unsentimental honesty. Kindness that refuses to lie to you.
cards.shadow: Coldness. Judgement sharpened by old hurt and applied a little too widely.
cards.reversed: Bitterness, harsh words, or a guard that never comes down.
cards.description: A stern queen sits with sword raised and one hand extended, clouds gathering below her throne.

cards.name: King of Swords
cards.essence: Judgement delivered without flinching.
cards.light: Intellectual authority used fairly. Principle held steady when it would be easier not to.
cards.shadow: Logic without warmth. Being technically correct and humanly useless.
cards.reversed: Abuse of authority, cold manipulation, or reason twisted to suit.
cards.description: A king sits facing forward holding an upright sword, butterflies and a crescent carved on his throne.

cards.name: Ace of Pentacles
cards.essence: A real opportunity, with weight to it.
cards.light: A solid new beginning in work, money or health. Something tangible offered.
cards.shadow: An opportunity left on the table, or prosperity chased for its own sake.
cards.reversed: A missed chance, poor planning, or a promising thing that fails to root.
cards.description: A hand from a cloud holds a golden pentacle above a walled garden with an arched gate.

cards.name: Two of Pentacles
cards.essence: Keeping both in the air, for now.
cards.light: Nimble handling of competing demands. Flexibility that keeps everything moving.
cards.shadow: Overcommitment. Juggling well enough that nobody notices you are drowning.
cards.reversed: Dropping a ball, disorganisation, or too much taken on.
cards.description: A figure dances while juggling two pentacles bound by an infinity ribbon, ships rolling on high seas behind.

cards.name: Three of Pentacles
cards.essence: Good work, done with the right people.
cards.light: Skilled collaboration where each contribution is valued. Competence being noticed.
cards.shadow: Design by committee, or doing the work while others take the meeting.
cards.reversed: Poor teamwork, unrecognised effort, or mediocrity accepted.
cards.description: A sculptor confers with two robed figures holding plans, in a cathedral under construction.

cards.name: Four of Pentacles
cards.essence: Holding on tightly, arms full.
cards.light: Sensible conservation of what you have. Boundaries around your resources and energy.
cards.shadow: Miserliness and fear of loss. Gripping so hard nothing new can be picked up.
cards.reversed: Letting go, generosity returning, or financial carelessness.
cards.description: A crowned man clutches one pentacle to his chest, stands on two more and balances a fourth on his head.

cards.name: Five of Pentacles
cards.essence: Out in the cold, walking past the lit window.
cards.light: Adversity survived together. Help is nearer than it looks, if you ask.
cards.shadow: Real material hardship, and the pride or shame that keeps you outside.
cards.reversed: Recovery, help accepted, or hardship easing at last.
cards.description: Two destitute figures trudge through snow past a stained glass window glowing with light.

cards.name: Six of Pentacles
cards.essence: Someone holds the scales, and it is not both of you.
cards.light: Generosity that flows properly. Giving when you can and receiving without shame.
cards.shadow: Strings attached. Charity that quietly buys control over the one receiving it.
cards.reversed: Debt, one-sided giving, or generosity used as leverage.
cards.description: A merchant drops coins into a beggar's hands while holding a set of scales in the other.

cards.name: Seven of Pentacles
cards.essence: Leaning on the hoe, wondering if it was worth it.
cards.light: Pausing to assess long effort honestly. Growth is happening at its own pace.
cards.shadow: Impatience with slow returns, or years sunk into a crop that will not ripen.
cards.reversed: Wasted effort, impatience, or abandoning something just before harvest.
cards.description: A young man leans on a hoe, regarding seven pentacles growing on a leafy bush.

cards.name: Eight of Pentacles
cards.essence: The same thing again, slightly better each time.
cards.light: Patient skill-building. Real mastery accumulating through unglamorous repetition.
cards.shadow: Grinding for its own sake. Perfectionism on something that stopped mattering.
cards.reversed: Sloppiness, lost motivation, or effort with no direction.
cards.description: A craftsman at a bench hammers a pentacle, seven finished ones displayed beside him.

cards.name: Nine of Pentacles
cards.essence: Comfort that nobody handed you.
cards.light: Earned comfort and genuine self-sufficiency. Enjoying what discipline built.
cards.shadow: Gilded isolation. Independence held so tightly that nobody is let into the garden.
cards.reversed: Financial setback, over-reliance on others, or luxury without contentment.
cards.description: A richly dressed woman stands in a vineyard with a hooded falcon resting on her gloved hand.

cards.name: Ten of Pentacles
cards.essence: Something built to outlast you.
cards.light: Lasting security and something worth passing on. Belonging across generations.
cards.shadow: Tradition as a cage. Wealth that comes with expectations attached.
cards.reversed: Family conflict, unstable finances, or a legacy that becomes a burden.
cards.description: An old man with dogs watches a couple and child beneath an archway, ten pentacles arranged over the scene.

cards.name: Page of Pentacles
cards.essence: Studying the thing carefully before touching it.
cards.light: Eager, grounded learning. Genuine willingness to start at the bottom and do it properly.
cards.shadow: Perpetual preparation. Studying the manual instead of starting the work.
cards.reversed: Procrastination, missed opportunity, or plans that stay theoretical.
cards.description: A youth in a green field holds a pentacle up with both hands, absorbed in examining it.

cards.name: Knight of Pentacles
cards.essence: Slow, steady, and actually arrives.
cards.light: Utterly dependable. Unspectacular persistence that finishes what it starts.
cards.shadow: Stubborn and slow. Routine mistaken for progress, caution for wisdom.
cards.reversed: Stagnation, boredom, or perfectionism grinding everything to a halt.
cards.description: An armoured knight sits motionless on a heavy black horse, holding a pentacle over ploughed fields.

cards.name: Queen of Pentacles
cards.essence: Practical care, quietly keeping everything alive.
cards.light: Warm, capable and grounded. Looking after people in concrete, useful ways.
cards.shadow: Self-neglect. Providing for everyone until there is nothing left for yourself.
cards.reversed: Smothering, financial worry, or losing yourself in caretaking.
cards.description: A queen sits in a flowering bower cradling a pentacle in her lap, a rabbit at her feet.

cards.name: King of Pentacles
cards.essence: Built it, kept it, knows exactly what it cost.
cards.light: Material mastery used generously. Reliable provision and shrewd, steady judgement.
cards.shadow: Measuring worth in holdings. Stubbornness and a grip that will not loosen.
cards.reversed: Greed, financial mismanagement, or status without substance.
cards.description: A king in a robe embroidered with grapes sits among vines, one hand on a pentacle, a castle behind.
